visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up view of dozens of spherical, golden-brown sesame biscuits arranged in neat rows on a weathered metal baking tray. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the white sesame seeds and the flaky crust of the pastries. (2) A pair of hands meticulously pulls apart a warm biscuit to reveal the internal layers of thinly shredded, pale radish filling. The motion is slow to emphasize the flakiness and the moisture within the savory snack. (3) The scene shifts to the exterior of a small urban storefront under a red striped awning. Several customers, including an older man in a purple jacket, stand in line at the counter. Motorized scooters are parked in the blurred foreground. (4) Inside the kitchen, a worker in a white cap, dark short-sleeved shirt, and brown apron is seen from behind. They are carefully sliding a large industrial baking sheet filled with dough balls into a high-capacity professional oven. (5) A middle-aged woman wearing a blue medical mask, a white baseball cap, and a brown apron stands behind a glass display case. She looks directly at the camera with a pleasant expression, gesturing toward the various food items. (6) A detailed shot of hands placing multiple golden-brown biscuits into clear plastic bags on a clean stainless steel counter. The background shows more stacks of finished goods and a yellow price list. (7) A sequence of rapid close-ups display different pastry varieties. One is broken to show a golden syrup-like sugar filling, another reveals a dark, dense red bean paste, and a third shows the cross-section of a thick green onion bread. (8) A hand holds a tall, white translucent plastic cup filled with creamy soy milk against the backdrop of the busy shop entrance. The lighting is slightly warmer, suggesting late afternoon sun. (9) A large, bright yellow menu board with red and black Chinese text is shown hanging above the pastry display. It lists various flavors like Radish Shred, Sweet Crust, and Red Bean, along with their prices. (10) The final shot shows the shop name and address in large text overlays against a blurred view of the storefront and street, concluding the promotional presentation.
